usability_notes: The grouped identity question can combine supported person-to-alias links with an unresolved lexical label; I use UNRESOLVED for that combined assertion in INV-C01 and preserve the supported subclaims.

The form does not specify whether an explicitly unsupported legacy proposal counts as a conflicting assertion. For INV-C02 episode_bindings I use CONFLICTING to retain the incompatible proposed and native episode assignments, without giving the legacy proposal source authority.
INV-C03 X and Y are hypothetical alternatives, not competing authenticated source assertions or reader answers; I use UNRESOLVED rather than CONFLICTING for the missing episode selection.
NOT_IN_INSPECTED_OBJECTS denotes a domain for which no substantive evidence is supplied, including when a toy line explicitly lists its absence; the required line_ids is therefore empty.
